root_cause.text: A deadlock occurs because ocfs2_unlink acquires the orphan dir inode_lock before ip_alloc_sem, while ocfs2_dio_end_io_write acquires ip_alloc_sem before the orphan dir inode_lock, creating an ABBA lock ordering violation.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message detail the lock chains (orphan dir inode_lock → ip_alloc_sem in unlink, and ip_alloc_sem → orphan dir inode_lock in dio_end_io_write) and the patch moves `down_write(&oi->ip_alloc_sem)` after `ocfs2_del_inode_from_orphan()` to break the deadlock.
